nodes.label: RaBitQ 1-bit quantization (32x memory)
nodes.rationale: 32x memory reduction via two-phase Hamming-prefilter + exact-rerank; for corpora >=5,000 vectors or memory-constrained envs (ADR-0001 sec.2).

nodes.label: ControllerRegistry / INIT_LEVELS (29 names, 6 levels)
nodes.rationale: Defer to runtime agentdb_controllers; stop hard-coding the stale '19 controllers' count (ADR-0001 sec.1).

nodes.label: Namespace convention contract
nodes.rationale: ruflo-agentdb owns naming (<plugin-stem>-<intent>) so downstream plugins don't re-invent; avoids key collisions in the bridge; reserved: pattern, claude-memories, default (ADR-0001 sec.4).

nodes.label: pattern-store fallback (memory-store-fallback, ADR-093)
nodes.rationale: When ReasoningBank registry returns null, agentdb_pattern-store writes through to memory_store; a controller:'memory-store-fallback' response is a persisted pattern, not an error (ADR-093 F4).

nodes.label: AES-256-GCM encryption at rest (ADR-096)
nodes.rationale: Opt-in encryption of .swarm/memory.db with fresh 12-byte IV; magic-byte (RFE1) sniff keeps legacy plaintext readable during migration (ADR-096).
